business.name: Bright Smile Dental Clinic
business.directions: Ring the brass bell marked 'Clinic' on the left of the main entrance. Paid parking is available on Market Street.
business.bookingInstructions: Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment and bring a list of any medication you are taking. If you feel unwell, call us instead of attending.
business.outOfScopeMessage: I can help with booking, changing or cancelling appointments. Anything clinical or billing related needs a member of our team, so I have flagged your message for them and they will contact you shortly.
business.escalationMessage: That sounds urgent, so I am not going to book a routine slot. Please call us now on +44 20 7946 0100. If you are having trouble breathing or the swelling is spreading, call 999.

conversation.greeting: Thanks for getting in touch with Bright Smile Dental Clinic. I can check availability and get you booked in. What do you need help with?
conversation.askForName: Happy to help. What is your full name?
conversation.askForEmail: Thanks. What is the best email address to send your confirmation to?
conversation.askForPhone: And the best phone number in case we need to reach you on the day?
conversation.askForService: Which service can I book for you?
conversation.askForTime: What day and time would suit you? For example: 'Tuesday at 2pm' or 'next Friday morning'.

services.name: Dental Check-up
services.description: Routine examination, X-rays if needed, and a treatment plan.
services.confirmationNote: No preparation needed, just bring your medication list.

services.name: Hygiene & Polish
services.description: Professional scale and polish with one of our hygienists.
services.confirmationNote: Avoid eating for one hour afterwards.

services.name: Teeth Whitening Consultation
services.description: Shade assessment and a personalised whitening plan.
services.confirmationNote: Bring any previous whitening trays with you.

services.name: Smile Design Consultation
services.description: In-depth consultation for veneers, implants and smile design.
services.confirmationNote: A £25 deposit is taken at the appointment, not online.
